item.title: Bulletin updated at 08:50 HKT 26/Feb/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Upper-air disturbances will bring a few rain patches to the coast of Guangdong today. With the upper-air disturbances departing and the northeast monsoon being replaced by a humid maritime airstream gradually in the next couple of days, temperatures will rise progressively over the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of this week and early next week. There may be damp days over the weekend. The weather will be foggy in the morning and at night. It will be warm during the day. The northeast monsoon is expected to affect southern China midweek next week. It will become cool appreciably with rain over the region.
